text: 关于卖淫问题的大讨论。
en: A major discussion on the issue of prostitution.

text: 彻底掀开了所谓法律制度的真相。
en: It completely laid bare the truth of the so-called legal system.

text: 真是意想不到的惊喜
en: Truly an unexpected surprise

text: 总不会到了今天还有人试图取得男女双方的共识吧？
en: Surely no one today is still trying to reach a consensus between men and women?

text: 属实农民可怜地主，丫鬟共情主子了。
en: Truly the peasant pities the landlord, and the maid empathises with her master.

text: 插个题外话。
en: A side note.

text: 北欧某国卖淫合法，女性失业不敢登记，因为一段时间失业后，就业机构就会推荐你从事卖淫工作，你不能拒绝，否则就会取消你的福利待遇。
en: In a certain Nordic country prostitution is legal; unemployed women dare not register, because after a period of unemployment the employment agency will recommend that you take up prostitution work, and you cannot refuse, otherwise your welfare benefits will be cancelled.

text: 合法逼良为娼
en: Legally forcing decent women into prostitution

text: 很多这样的言论，或者说至少类似，有些可能会精确一点，不说北欧而是说德国。
en: Many such statements — or at least similar ones — and some might be more precise, not naming a Nordic country but naming Germany.

text: 然而没人考虑过真实性吗？
en: Yet has no one considered whether it is true?

text: 这玩意年龄比某些知乎er年龄还大，这是在2002年德国出台《色情交易法》卖淫合法化后，一些英美媒体对德国政府给失业女性介绍性服务工作的报道，出现了数次，后都有辟谣，既有路透社的辟谣，也有德国之声和德国劳工局的辟谣。
en: This thing is older than some Zhihu users. It dates to after Germany enacted the Prostitution Act and legalised prostitution in 2002, when some Anglo-American media reported that the German government referred unemployed women to sex-work jobs. It appeared several times, and each was later debunked — there were debunkings by Reuters, and also by Deutsche Welle and the German Federal Employment Agency.

text: 说白了，这玩意就是2002年左右德国媒体打嘴炮论战卖淫是否应该合法化时提出的一个假设，后被英国报纸大肆报道，扩散开来以后有严肃媒体跟进并发现是假新闻。
en: To put it bluntly, this was a hypothesis put forward around 2002, when German media were arguing over whether prostitution should be legalised; it was later widely reported by British newspapers, and after it spread, serious media followed up and found it to be fake news.

text: 有趣的是此刻使用宛如又回到了2002年，也在讨论卖淫是否应该合法化。
en: Interestingly, using it right now feels as if we had returned to 2002, once again debating whether prostitution should be legalised.

text: 无趣的是居然还要用别人二十多年前的话术，好不容易搞了点新话术还有严重的逻辑错误…
en: What is dull is that we still have to use other people's rhetoric from over twenty years ago; having barely come up with some new rhetoric, it is already riddled with serious logical errors…

text: 如果卖淫的定义是有金钱交易的性关系。
en: If the definition of prostitution is a sexual relationship involving a monetary transaction.

text: 那么彩礼是什么？
en: Then what is the bride price?

text: 吸烟有害健康
en: Smoking is harmful to health

text: 那还卖烟
en: Yet cigarettes are still sold

text: 而且还不让私人卖
en: And private individuals are not allowed to sell them either

text: 哪有什么好不好对不对
en: What is there of good or bad, right or wrong

text: 看谁掌握定义权而已
en: It simply comes down to who holds the power to define.

text: 有一天性交易合法化
en: One day, should sex work be legalised,

text: 自然有注经人
en: there will naturally be those who annotate the scriptures.

text: 现在不必争论这些
en: There is no need to argue about these things now.

text: 浪费口舌而已
en: It is just a waste of breath.

text: 有那功夫
en: With that energy,

text: 多洗洗脚
en: go wash your feet a bit more;

text: 按按摩
en: get a massage;

text: 消费不就上来了
en: and won't consumption pick up?

text: 没事，彩礼已经快被最高法承认为合法的嫖资了，过段时间没准各地的官方指导价就出来了
en: No worries — the bride price has nearly been recognised by the Supreme Court as a legitimate prostitution fee; in a while, official guidance prices may well appear in various localities.

text: 卖淫不合法而包养合法的底层逻辑是：
en: The underlying logic of why prostitution is illegal yet keeping a mistress is legal is:

text: 增加被统治阶级行使性权利的难度，以提高统治阶级行使性权利的数量和质量。
en: to raise the difficulty for the ruled class to exercise their sexual rights, so as to increase the quantity and quality of the sexual rights exercised by the ruling class.

text: 打击杀人放火有道理
en: Cracking down on murder and arson makes sense,

text: 因为杀人放火有明确受害者
en: because murder and arson have clear victims;

text: 同理，电信诈骗也有
en: by the same logic, telecom fraud does too.

text: 你警察不管，受害者就会去告状
en: If the police do not act, the victims will go and file complaints.

text: 但卖淫嫖娼，你说不出谁是受害者
en: But in prostitution and soliciting, you cannot say who the victim is.

text: 有人说，家庭另一半是受害者
en: Some say the spouse is the victim.

text: 但问题是，如果双方都没有配偶呢？
en: But the problem is, what if neither party has a spouse?

text: 又有人说，卖淫嫖娼影响社会良俗
en: Others say prostitution and soliciting harm social mores.

text: 但问题是，社会良俗是人发明的
en: But the problem is, social mores were invented by people.

text: 一来，你没法确保这个人发明的对
en: First, you cannot be sure that what this person invented is correct;

text: 二来，社会良俗是动态的，是不断改变的
en: second, social mores are dynamic and constantly changing.

text: 还有人说，禁止卖淫是新中国建立的成果
en: Others say banning prostitution was an achievement of the founding of New China.

text: 但新中国建立时，还反对投机倒把呢
en: But when New China was founded, it also opposed speculation and profiteering;

text: 还要求公私合营呢，现在都不坚持了
en: it also demanded public–private joint operation, which is no longer upheld today.

text: 我对合法与否没态度
en: I hold no stance on whether it is legal or not,

text: 但是逻辑要摆明白
en: but the logic must be made clear.

text: 特别是想象的东西，更要警惕
en: Especially with imagined things, one must be all the more vigilant.

text: 你反驳不了我
en: You cannot refute me.

text: 包二奶、搞外围、海天盛宴、100个情妇这些都不算卖淫，都是合法的！
en: Keeping a second wife, having a mistress on the side, the Haitian Shengyan, a hundred mistresses — none of these count as prostitution, all are legal!

text: 那么社会底层的穷男人，拿个几百块钱去擦边解决需求，这个又不道德又违法
en: Then the poor men at the bottom of society, who spend a few hundred yuan to meet their needs at the margins, are deemed both immoral and illegal.

text: 是谁更虚伪没有道德？
en: Who is the more hypocritical and morally bankrupt one?

text: 社会经济学的书说了，这不是小事，这是对底层人民的性压迫和性压榨
en: Books on socio-economics say this is no small matter; it is sexual oppression and sexual exploitation of the people at the bottom.

text: 用这种方法把底层男人的性需求堵死，好让他们为了娶妻，买车、买房，还要给几十万彩礼，掏空家庭积蓄，以后还要给后代准备这些钱，一辈子当打工奴隶，供养者，不是这样吗？
en: Using this method to block the sexual needs of lower-class men, so that in order to marry they buy a car, buy a house, and also pay hundreds of thousands in bride price, emptying the family savings, and later must prepare this money for the next generation — remaining wage slaves and providers all their lives — is it not so?

text: 这不就是现代版的放羊娃无限循环吗？
en: Is this not the modern version of the shepherd boy's infinite loop?

text: 同时也压榨底层女性，她们本来可以随便卖卖就过上轻松的生活，但是由于法律只支持高端，大部分年轻女性从事这一行之后，只能去卷，都会去医美、包装自己，进而消耗掉自己的青春，只有医美、服装、妈妈桑、皮条客这些吸血鬼还有上层男性是最终的赢家，而这些人又会被更高级的资本用金融手段收割！
en: At the same time it also exploits lower-class women. They could originally have sold themselves casually and lived an easy life, but because the law only supports the high end, after most young women enter this trade they can only compete in a relentless rat race; they all turn to cosmetic procedures and package themselves, thereby consuming their youth. Only the cosmetic clinics, fashion, the mamasangs and the pimps — these vampires — together with upper-class men are the ultimate winners, and these people in turn are harvested by even higher-level capital through financial means!

text: 所以你反驳不了我，因为那里有压迫，那里就有反抗！
en: So you cannot refute me, because where there is oppression, there is resistance!

text: 你们这些虚伪的强盗！
en: You hypocritical robbers!

text: 觉醒吧！
en: Awaken!

text: 底层的人民啊！
en: People at the bottom!

text: 这里有个误区：卖淫合法不代表组织卖淫合法。
en: Here is a misconception: legalising prostitution does not mean organising prostitution is legal.

text: 世界上很多卖淫合法的国家，组织卖淫是违法的！
en: In many countries of the world where prostitution is legal, organising prostitution is illegal!

text: 我想有脑子的人都能分辨其中的区别。
en: I think anyone with a brain can tell the difference.

text: 在讨论卖淫合法问题前，我想先问个问题：
en: Before discussing the prostitution-legalisation issue, I would like to ask a question first:

text: 已知：国内没有合法渠道看色情片，使用VPN违法，下载色情片属于“情节较轻”。
en: Given: domestically there is no legal channel to watch pornographic films; using a VPN is illegal; downloading pornographic films counts as 'a relatively minor offence'.

text: 请问：单身成年男性如何在完全合法的情况下，解决自己的性需求？
en: Question: how can a single adult male satisfy his sexual needs in a completely legal manner?

text: 我反对卖淫合法，但我也希望某些组织请停止使用性剥削这种下贱手段来控制男性。
en: I oppose the legalisation of prostitution, but I also hope certain organisations will stop using sexual exploitation, this base method, to control men.

text: 不说性自由，请让中国男性先飞机自由。
en: Forget sexual freedom — please let Chinese men have the freedom to masturbate first.

text: 合法化后
en: After legalisation,

text: 手机上会多出几个app
en: a few extra apps will appear on your phone.

text: 点进去会有照片介绍跟视频介绍，附带体检报告，往下拉会看到评价，估计四星往下接客量很少
en: Clicking in, there will be photo and video introductions, with attached medical examination reports; scrolling down you will see reviews, and presumably those rated four stars and below get very few clients.

text: 完事后为了要个好评会说亲避孕套免费哦，给你优惠十块给个好评吧。
en: After finishing, to get a good review they will say, 'dear, condoms are free — I'll give you a ten-yuan discount if you leave a good review'.

text: 平台会定期对部分从业人员培训，然后打上专业标识
en: The platform will periodically train some of its workers and then mark them with a professional badge.

text: 除了按照年龄颜值等分类，你还可以根据特惠一口价(包含情趣用品)，快餐，尊享，至尊来寻找合适的
en: Besides categorising by age, looks and so on, you can also search for a suitable match according to special one-price deals (including adult products), fast food, premium, and supreme tiers.

text: 除了专职，更多的是兼职，因为平台注册简单，一般抽佣百分之三十，外加每单五块介绍费。
en: Apart from full-time workers, there are more part-time ones, because platform registration is simple; generally a thirty-per-cent commission is taken, plus a five-yuan referral fee per order.

text: 首先声明，我反对卖淫，也反对卖淫合法化。
en: First, a disclaimer: I oppose prostitution, and I also oppose its legalisation.

text: 但是某些人反对卖淫合法化的逻辑实在是不行…
en: But the logic with which some people oppose legalising prostitution is really no good…

text: 最典型的，就是“我不希望我妻女卖淫，所以我反对卖淫合法化”
en: The most typical is: 'I do not want my wife and daughter to prostitute themselves, so I oppose legalising prostitution.'

text: 这个逻辑的问题在于，现在包养不违法，约炮也不违法
en: The problem with this logic is that keeping a mistress is not illegal now, nor is casual hook-up.

text: 难道你希望你妻女被包养?难道你希望你妻女去约炮？
en: Do you want your wife and daughter to be kept as mistresses? Do you want your wife and daughter to go hooking up?

text: 我觉得，排除个别兴趣特殊的，大部分人肯定都不希望吧…
en: I think that, excluding a few with special interests, most people certainly would not wish for that…

text: 但是，为啥卖淫违法，这俩不违法呢？
en: But why is prostitution illegal while those two are not?

text: 而且上文里我还只在性方面谈论这个问题，没搞扩大化呢，要是搞了扩大化，这个逻辑就更难绷，比如我不希望我的亲友（无论男女）去挖矿、去做环卫工、去当掏粪工、去纹身…
en: Moreover, in what I wrote above I only discussed this in terms of sex, without extending the argument; if one did extend it, this logic becomes even more untenable — for example, I do not want my relatives and friends (regardless of gender) to go mining, to be sanitation workers, to be cesspit cleaners, or to get tattooed…

text: 我不希望亲友去做的事情可多了。
en: There are ever so many things I do not want my relatives and friends to do.

text: 看了那么多答案，我只能说，从感情上我反对卖淫合法化，并且洁身自好不去嫖。
en: Having read so many answers, I can only say that emotionally I oppose legalising prostitution, and I keep myself clean and do not visit prostitutes.

text: 但从理论上，确实找不到反对卖淫合法化的合理逻辑。
en: But theoretically, one truly cannot find a reasonable logic for opposing the legalisation of prostitution.
